answer.rationale: Regional failover is the only one-shot intervention that directly removes the write-path degradation while keeping the security patch in place. Memory b2 confirms that regional failover during the March degradation restored latency quickly with clean traffic shifting and error-rate recovery within minutes; verifying it confirms the mechanism and guardrails to reuse. Memory b5 confirms that routing report queries to read replicas offloaded the primary and restored transactional write latency; verifying it confirms whether read-replica routing can be used as a supplemental, later-window action to keep the failover window safe while settlement writes are heavy. This combination preserves customer writes, avoids rollback of the compliance-mandated security patch, and maximizes sustained availability under heavy settlement traffic.
